name: Musume Manager! Ikimasu!! ~SEX a GAME 2017~
original_name: 娘マネジ！イキます !！ ～SEX a GAME 2017～
source:
Misaki Ariake's dad is the manager of a college baseball team. He was let go for poor results, but did really well in his new post. He even developed a rivalry with another team: Kabayaki University.

Kabayaki University manages to consistently produce some of professional baseball's greatest talent. Against them, Ariake's team has no chance... but they do have... Misaki!

If it'll help her dad win, she'll do anything... Even use her own body!

And the baseball world will never be the same...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ198052.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有明美咲的父亲是大学棒球队的教练。他因成绩不佳被解雇，却在新岗位上干得相当出色，甚至与另一支球队蒲烧大学形成竞争关系。

蒲烧大学一直能培养出顶尖职业棒球人才。面对他们，有明的球队毫无胜算……不过，他们还有……美咲！

只要能帮助父亲获胜，她什么都愿意做……甚至献出自己的身体！

棒球世界将从此改变……
